title: WATCH What Happens When You Stop Worrying & Start Trusting God (Daily Jesus Devotional)
paragraphs: no matter what you're going through right now remember that God loves you today his reassuring voice is saying to you I've got this we're also going to pray a powerful prayer with you calling on God to deliver you from every worry and to bless you abundantly in the name of Jesus so watch until the end and open your heart to receive the blessings of this prayer imagine you have a big balloon every time you worry about something it's like blowing air

into that balloon at first it might seem okay but if you keep blowing air into it with all your worries it might get too big and burst that balloon is like our minds if we fill it with too many worries it becomes too much for us to handle everyone everywhere has their own stories about worry maybe it's the fear of a coming storm when the sky gets cloudy perhaps it's the nervous feeling when waiting for some news or some test results

or maybe you're worried about your health your financial situation your overall success your relationships among other things if we really give place to worry there can be a lot to worry about these worries over time can make us feel heavy like we're carrying a big full balloon everywhere we go now let's look at what the Bible has to say about all this there's a quiet beautiful Moment In the bible where jesus talks about birds he points out that they don't store

up food in big barns or get worried about tomorrow yet they always have enough to eat why because God takes care of them Jesus then asks in Matthew 6 verse 26 aren't you much more valuable than they it's a gentle reminder that if God looks after the birds he will surely look after us perhaps it's about time we take a leaf out of the bird's book don't you think you'll bet a bird never worries about where its food will come from

tomorrow or what if the trees lose their branches or if the rivers run dry they don't fret over where they'll Nest next season or if the upcoming winter will be too harsh their little hearts don't get weighed down by thoughts of predators lurking or if their song will be good enough they soar and sing trusting in the rhythm of Nature and the provision of God we can learn a lot from them I really think so in Matthew 6 27 Jesus says

can any one of you by worrying at a single hour to your life this is a simple but powerful question if we think about it worrying doesn't make our day longer or solve our problems instead it makes us feel tired and heavy in simple words the Bible reminds us that constantly worrying is like trying to fly with a big heavy balloon it holds us back instead we should let go of our worries have faith and remember that God is always with

us and he's taking care of us by doing this we can feel light free and full of Hope let us put our trust in God's transformative power God's power to turn situations around our situation may not be ideal at the moment we might find ourselves surrounded by challenges doubts or even feelings of despair in these times it's natural to wonder if things will ever change or if there's a way out yet amidst the uncertainty there's a Beacon of Hope we can

cling to the unyielding faithfulness and power of God the Bible is filled with instances that affirm God's transformative power one of the most profound declarations comes from the prophet Isaiah who relayed God's promise to his people in Isaiah 43 Verse 19. behold I will do a new thing now it shall spring forth shall you not know it I will even make a road in the wilderness and rivers in the desert these words weren't just meant for the people of that time

they Echo with relevance for us today when it seems like we're trapped in a Wilderness of problems or stranded in a desert of hopelessness God assures us that he can and will create a path forward he promises to bring life and hope even in the bleakest situations so if you think you have a big problem God is bigger than your problem God's vision for our lives is filled with hope and prosperity even when our current situation seems far from ideal we

must remember that God's plans for us are always for our good our current circumstances may feel like they're too much to bear and the road ahead might seem unclear but let's take heart and remember that God is an expert at turning situations around he specializes in creating opportunities and pathways where none seem to exist in our moments of doubt and despair let's trust in his infinite wisdom and power to lead us to better days after all if he can make rivers

in the desert and roads in the wilderness there's nothing too challenging for him to handle in our lives right now let us take a closer look at the nature of worry it's important to understand that there's a difference between concern and worry concern is like checking the weather before going out you want to make sure you're prepared maybe you'll take an umbrella if it looks like it's going to rain it's okay to have concerns having a concern is about thinking ahead

in a helpful way but worry is different worry is like checking the weather every minute even when you're already safe inside your home it's letting the thought of rain take over your day even if there's only a small chance of it happening so now that you know the difference stop saying you're worried when you're probably just concerned and if you find that you're truly worried about something talk to God about it the whole idea here is to help you to overcome

worry so when making reference to yourself it's important to start exercising faith and use the word worry less and less there's a part in the Bible where King Saul was extremely worried about David instead of ruling his kingdom Saul spent days and nights chasing David because of his intense jealousy and fear this worry and Obsession consumed him taking away his peace strength and even the stability of his kingdom the Bible speaks about this heavy feeling of worry and proverbs 12 25

where it says anxiety in a man's heart weighs him down but a good word makes him glad this verse paints a clear picture worry is like a heavy Rock in our hearts it makes everything harder but kind words encouragement and positivity can help lift that weight and that's why I encourage you right now to give it to Jesus God will take care of you he's done it for countless others and I believe that he will do it for you just continue

to trust him don't lose hope so there is power in good words they can help us push away those heavy worries even if it's just for a little while in simple terms worry ties us down it's like trying to walk with heavy weights on our feet we get tired quickly and we can't move freely but when we let go of these worries when we listen to good words and remember that God is with us we can move freely we can find

our strength our joy and our peace again so next time you find yourself worrying too much try to let go of that heavy weight watch this video again and you will begin to feel better remember with God by your side and with a few good words you can find your way back to peace and happiness we serve a mighty God who is an ever-present anchor in our lives no matter how big the waves of Life get or how stormy things seem

God is always there to keep us steady and safe sometimes we might feel like God is far away especially when things are tough but the truth is God never leaves us even when we can't feel him he's always there like a shadow that never goes away Psalm 46 verse 1 reminds us of this it says God is our refuge and strength an ever-present help in trouble just like an anchor for a ship God's power wisdom and love are always there to

hold on to in Daniel Chapter 3 The Bible Tells of the story of Shadrach Meshach and Abednego they were thrown into a fiery furnace because they wouldn't stop worshiping God but they weren't alone in the fire a fourth figure believed to be an angel or even the presence of God was there with them and they came out without even a smell of smoke this story reminds us that no matter how hot the fire or how big the challenge God is always

with us long ago many people faced big worries and challenges but they overcame these problems by trusting in God think of David he later became a king after spending years of running away from people who wanted to hurt him but even when hiding in caves he trusted God Psalm 56 verse 3. which David wrote says when I'm afraid I put my trust in you just like David when we trust God we find Solutions and peace the peace that surpasses all understanding

it's a special kind of peace that is hard to explain but it's very real it's like that peace that would confuse the enemy when we give all our worries to God and talk to him about them he gives us this amazing peace in return you too can experience that peace just put your trust in God and he will do the rest Philippians 4 verses 6 to 7 says do not be anxious about anything but in every situation by prayer and petition

with Thanksgiving present your requests to God and the peace of God which transcends all understanding will guard your hearts and your minds in Christ Jesus this means that God's peace is like a shield it keeps our hearts and Minds safe from all the worries and scary things so whenever you're feeling worried or scared remember Bible verses like these remember that God is like an anchor always there to keep us safe remember the people who trusted God long ago and found peace

and always remember the special peace that God gives which is like a soft pillow for our hearts and Minds now let us look at some practical steps to trusting God and overcoming worry firstly we need to be able to recognize worry and redirect our thoughts worry is like an unwanted guest that sneaks into our minds sometimes we might not even notice when we start to worry it's like when a room gets Messier bit by bit we might not notice the mess

until it's really big to trust God more we need to spot these worry moments quickly and decide to think differently it's like seeing that the room is getting messy and deciding to clean it up right away let's think about Joseph in the Bible his story is found in Genesis chapters 37 to 50. he had a lot of reasons to worry don't you think his brothers sold him he was falsely accused and thrown into prison and he faced many hard times but

instead of letting worry control him he chose to trust in God every time he faced a problem he turned to God and did what was right he continued to have faith in God and walking in obedience despite his circumstances he didn't say how could I believe in God and be so unfortunate or where is God in all this or I will stop believing and trusting God and there were many other negative thoughts that could come to his mind but Joseph remained

faithful putting his trust in God and in the end God lifted him up to be a leader in Egypt secondly we need to harness the power of prayer and letting go prayer is like having a direct phone line to God when we're worried instead of keeping it to ourselves we can tell God about it but sometimes we forget to pray about our worries this is something that has happened to me personally I have had to remind myself to pray instead of

worrying and I can tell you this God has been faithful to me he is faithful you just need to trust him remember God can handle our biggest problems by praying we're handing over our problems to someone much bigger and stronger than us so let go and let God invite the holy spirit to guide you into all truth and bring you hope and comfort there's a story in the Bible about a man named Hezekiah in Second Kings 19 verses 14 to 19.

big armies wanted to attack his City and the enemies even made fun of God instead of panicking Hezekiah took a letter from these enemies and spread it out before God in the temple and prayed God heard his prayer and protected the city this reminds us that we should pray and trust in God is there a paper in your possession that is making you worried be like Hezekiah spread it out before God pray about it trusting God wait and see what happens

and remember to come back and share your testimony with us we love to hear testimonies about God's grace and goodness it encourages us and it encourages others thirdly in order to overcome worry we need to embrace scriptures that combat worry the Bible is like a treasure chest full of words that can help us when we're worried by reading and thinking about these words we can push away worry and bring in peace consider the birds and the flowers in The Sermon on

the Mount Jesus himself points to Nature as a reminder of God's care he says in Matthew 6 26 look at the birds of the air they do not sow or reap or store away in Barns and yet your heavenly father feeds them are you not much more valuable than they this verse nudges us to remember our worth in God's eyes and his constant provision in the book of Isaiah there's another reassuring verse Isaiah 41 verse 10 states fear not for I

Am With You be not dismayed for I am your God I will strengthen you yes I will help you I will uphold you with my righteous right hand this is a profound promise from God assuring us of his unwavering presence and support and how about first Peter 5 7. where we are gently reminded cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you this verse doesn't just acknowledge our worries it offers a solution to cast or give them over to

God it's an invitation to trust knowing that God is more than capable of carrying our burdens each of these verses and many more scattered throughout the Bible serve as lifelines and stormy seas in times of worry and anxiety when we immerse ourselves in these scriptures they help us shift our Focus nurture our faith and diminish our worries the word of God is alive and active and when we let it penetrate our hearts it becomes an armor against the fiery darts of

anxiety embracing these scriptures is like holding on to a shield knowing that behind it we're safe protected and loved so read and meditate upon God's word and push your worries away and lastly we need to get connected with a support system of believers a faith-filled community just like when we play on a team it's good to have people around us who can help having friends who believe in God can make trusting him a lot easier they can pray with us listen

to us and remind us of God's promises for those who are looking for such a team our daily Jesus devotional YouTube channel is a great place it's like a big family where everyone helps each other get closer to God remember the story of the four friends who carried a paralyzed man to Jesus in Mark 2 verses 1 to 12 they even made a hole in the roof to get their friend to Jesus because of the crown with their help the man

was healed this shows a power of having a group of spiritually supportive friends so the next time worry tries to sneak in say to yourself nope not today Satan or you may say I give it to Jesus also remember these steps spot the worry talk to God about it read his comforting words and lean on your supportive friends in Christ with these steps and God by our side we can face anything now there are positive outcomes of trusting God when we

decide to trust God it's like planting a tiny seed in the ground over time with care trust and patience this seed grows into a strong towering tree trusting God brings some wonderful things into our lives first our faith grows just like muscles get bigger and stronger when we exercise our faith gets stronger when we trust God during hard times every time we see God helping us our belief in him gets even bigger in first Samuel chapter 17. there's a story about

a young Shepherd boy named David he trusted God when he faced a giant named Goliath even though Goliath was big and scary David's trust in God was even bigger because of his trust David defeated Goliath with just a sling and a stone this big victory made David's Faith grow even more next our trust in God makes our relationships with others better when our hearts are full of God's peace it's like carrying a bright Lantern in the dark people are drawn to

the light they see the peace we have and want to be close to it we become like helpers showing others the way to find this peace too in Matthew 5 16 the scripture tells us let your light so shine before men that they may see your good works and glorify your father in Heaven lastly trusting God helps us to better see his love and help in our lives it's like putting on glasses that help us see clearly we start noticing the

little and big ways God is helping us think of the story of Ruth even when things looked really bad for her she trusted in God and guess what God guided her every step he led her to a field owned by a kind man named Boaz because of her Trust Ruth's life changed in beautiful ways and she became part of the family line of King David and even Jesus this story can be found in the Book of Ruth the Bible puts it

beautifully in Jeremiah 17 verses 7 to 8. it says if we trust in God will be like strong trees by the water always green and always giving good fruit so even when it's hot and dry we won't be afraid because our trust is deep in God you can live a life free from the chains of worry imagine carrying a big heavy bag everywhere you go this bag is full of worries now imagine if someone kind and strong tells you hey give

me that heavy bag I'll carry it for you that's what God is telling us he's asking us to give him all our worries remember first Peter 5 7 which tells us cast all your anxiety on him because he cares for you when we do this it's like taking off that heavy bag we feel light and free we can live without that heavy weight so why would you keep holding on to that Bang why would you keep those chains of worry around

you let's decide today to trust God to give him all our worries when we do we'll find a life full of joy peace and freedom let us be free like a bird in the tree it's the Beautiful Life God wants for all of us let's take a moment to breathe deeply drawing a full breath then let it out slowly as you release your breath Envision all your concerns and worries flowing out with it let a gentle smile touch your lips allow

the peace to settle in and wholeheartedly place your trust in God stop worrying and trust him just believe it and feel an instant shift from worry to Hope now to all those within the sound of my voice let us go to the Lord in prayer I want you to pray this prayer with me so that you can have all the blessings of this prayer let us pray to our gracious and loving God dear heavenly father you are truly awesome you're the

creator of the heavens and the Earth You're The God Who Parts the Red Seas Who provided Manna From Heaven for the Israelites and who made the walls of Jericho fall you raise Lazarus from the dead healed the Blind and walked on water your miracles both in the past and present remind us daily of your Limitless power and boundless love every Miracle underscores the truth that You O Lord are greater than any challenge we Face Lord I come to you with an

open heart acknowledging that I have sometimes allowed worries to overshadow my trust in you father I seek your forgiveness as I forgive all those who have come against me I ask for your forgiveness for those moments of doubt and for not always leaning on your infinite wisdom and power in the mighty name of Jesus I declare that every chain of anxiety that binds me is broken I rebuke the spirit of worry and fear that tries to consume my mind and heart

every thought that does not align with your promises I cast it down in Jesus name Lord I declare that my trust in you will grow stronger each day and the peace that only you can give will guard my heart Thank You Lord for deliverance from worry anxiety and fear Lord I bring before you the things that weigh heavy on my heart I ask for the grace to fully trust in your Provisions both naturally and spiritually may your Holy Spirit give me

comfort in the knowledge that you are in control father may your Holy Spirit Enlighten my heart and reveal all truth to me may your peace surround me like a shield dear Lord so that every aspect of my life is taken care of father may you grant me protection from every harm visible or hidden shower your Abundant Blessings upon me so I may be a testament to your grace and goodness may you heal every wound both physical and emotional and renew my

strength may you open doors of breakthrough where there seem to be walls and guide my steps towards success deliver me from every force or influence that seeks to oppress me ensuring that I remain under your shadow of protection through all this may your name be glorified for you are the source of all good things father I lift up my loved ones to you may you touch their hearts with your Amazing Grace and goodness Lord may they too experience the freedom from

worry that comes from casting all their cares upon you as they walk through valleys or stand on mountaintops may you be their constant guide and protector as I say this prayer together with everyone listening Lord I Thank you for all the hearts that are humbled before you right now I pray that your comforting presence surround us that our trust in you multiplies and that a fresh wind of Hope fills our hearts May every Whisper of worry and fear be silenced in

the powerful name of Jesus Lord May every tear of worry be replaced with tears of gratitude and may Our Lives be Testaments to your unwavering love and care thank you Lord for hearing and answering my prayer in Jesus's mighty name I pray amen if you were blessed by this message type the word amen in the comments section below I declare that all the blessings of this prayer are now upon you in the name of Jesus you can help us to reach

more persons and spread the gospel you can do this by sharing the video with a friend or family member who you know need the blessing of this prayer and by clicking the like button also remember to subscribe to the channel for more videos that will bless your heart and uplift your spirit we appreciate all those who support us you're blessed to be a blessing please feel free to leave your prayer request in the comments section so that we can present them

before God for your blessings and victory we also invite other believers on the YouTube platform and all over the world to join us and start praying for you right now and we want you to know that even if you don't see a reply to your prayer request it doesn't mean that you were not prayed for rest assured we are actively lifting up each request to God that is in accordance with his will we believe in the power of prayer to bring

comfort healing and guidance in accordance with God's perfect plan stand in faith with us while we pray to God be all the glory May the grace and peace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all foreign
